integrity: The claim is derived from the published exact band condition and finite-index collapse formula; numerical checks are supplementary and are not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the \(\alpha=0\) square-lattice interpolation and normalized Lebesgue spectral measure in one high-energy cell.
No optimal finite-index convergence rate, density-of-states limit, negative-spectrum statement, or \(\alpha\ne0\) analogue is claimed.
An equivalent singular-scaling formulation under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Double-scaling band-fraction pinch in an interpolating square quantum graph
